verdict.rationale: Atlas explicitly supports creating, sending, and tracking SAFEs from the Dashboard, plus Cooley-developed legal document templates, vesting/cliff customization, and 83(b) filings, which covers much of the standard-terms fundraising paperwork flow. However, evidence doesn't confirm convertible notes are supported (only SAFEs are named), and community feedback notes Atlas doesn't eliminate the need for a lawyer/accountant for edge cases. Missing for 10: convertible note support, hands-on confirmation of SAFE generation/signing quality, and independent corroboration beyond Stripe's own docs.
